_note: Japan -> US landed-cost rules for a Buyee proxy purchase. Every rule has value, as_of (the date we checked the source) and url. status=verified means the number was read on the url on as_of; status=estimate means it could not be confirmed and 'tried' says what we checked. Schema: see shopper/cost/rules.py.

fx_jpy_per_usd.note: Fed H.10 (release 2026-11-16), JAPAN YEN 159.9300 on Nov 13 2026, the latest noon buying rate published. Buyee settles at the market rate between 11:00 and 12:00 JST, so the real rate can differ slightly.

buyee_service_fee_jpy.note: Purchase fee: flat rate 500 JPY per order (auction / Mercari / Rakuma: per successful bid or purchase; shopping: per store order).

buyee_plan_fee_jpy.note: Standard Plan 500 / Insured Delivery Plan 500 / Inspection Plan 300 / Lite Plan 0 JPY per item. Default is standard (inspection + insurance) because buyers of used items usually want both.

payment_fee_jpy.note: The Buyee usage-fee page lists no payment handling fee (checked 2026-11-20). Card issuer FX fees are outside this model.

consolidation_fee_jpy.note: Effective December 21, 2022 the consolidation fee is waived. Protective packaging that results in multiple packages is 1,500 JPY per package (not modeled).

customs_clearance_fee_jpy.note: If you send item(s) valued over 200,000 yen with EMS, AIR, SAL or Japan Post Seamail, a customs clearance commission fee (2,800 yen) is charged.

domestic_shipping_jpy.note: Rakuraku Mercari-bin Takkyubin: 60 size (up to 2kg) 750, 80 size 850, 100 size 1,050, 120 size 1,200 JPY. The 5/10/15kg limits of the 80/100/120 sizes are Yamato's standard size limits (estimate, not printed on this page). Used when the listing does not say the seller pays shipping; Buyee says domestic shipping generally ranges 150-1,500 JPY.

domestic_shipping_seller_paid.note: Applied when listing.fields['shipping'] is 'seller_paid' / 'included' / 送料込み.

default_weight_kg.tried: No source gives a typical weight; 1.0 kg is our assumption when a listing has no weight. Packaging adds weight, see packaging_kg.
default_weight_kg.note: Fallback package weight when listing.weight_kg is missing.

packaging_kg.tried: Buyee does not publish a packaging weight; 0.2 kg is our assumption for a box and padding.
packaging_kg.note: Added to listing weight before choosing a shipping band.

intl_shipping_us.note: US = Japan Post Fourth Zone (incl. Guam and US territories); EMS page says tentative extra charges are included for zones 3 and 4. Small-packet bands are only the weights we read (100g, 200g, 300g, 500g, 1kg, 1.5kg, 2kg airmail; 100g, 500g, 1kg, 2kg surface), so in-between weights round up to the next listed band (may overstate slightly). Buyee Air Delivery (FedEx/DHL/UPS) and ECMS are offered to the US but Buyee publishes no fixed rate table (estimator is JavaScript), so they are not modeled. Buyee lists SAL as suspended.

shipping_method_policy.note: cheapest_tracked (default, Buyee recommends EMS) | cheapest (allows untracked small packets) | fastest. Buyee shipping-method page: EMS 4-8 days Recommended; AIR 6-12 days; Seamail 1-3 months.

us_de_minimis.note: CBP e-commerce FAQ (last modified Nov 06, 2026): indefinite suspension of the de minimis exemption applies to merchandise valued at $800 or less arriving via all modes, including the international postal network (EO 14324 as amended by EO 14388). So every item pays duty regardless of value.

camera.desc: Digital still image video cameras: Free

lens.desc: Objective lenses for cameras (estimate, not read on 2026-11-20)

trading_cards.desc: Playing cards: Free (classification of TCG under 9504.40 vs 9504.90 not confirmed)

watch.desc: 40c each + 8.5% on the case + 14% on the strap + 5.3% on the battery

default.desc: Fallback when the category is unknown (estimate)

us_duty_mfn_by_category.note: General (Column 1) rates read from the USITC HTS search API on 2026-11-20. Watch is a compound rate; we use 40c + 8.5% of the item value (treating the whole value as the case) and mark it estimate. Unknown categories use the 5% default (estimate).

us_additional_duty_japan.tried: HTS API shows heading 9903.03.01: 'The duty provided in the applicable subheading + 10%' for articles of any country. Supreme Court struck IEEPA tariffs on 2026-02-20 (Learning Resources v. Trump, https://www.supremecourt.gov/opinions/slipopinion/25) and CBP is refunding IEEPA duties (https://www.cbp.gov/trade/programs-administration/trade-remedies/ieepa-duty-refunds). We could not confirm the legal authority or end date of 9903.03.01, so it is applied as a conservative estimate.
us_additional_duty_japan.note: Extra ad-valorem duty on Japanese goods on top of the MFN rate. Set to 0 to drop it.

battery_loose.reason: standalone lithium batteries cannot be shipped overseas via any shipping method

power_bank.reason: power banks are standalone lithium batteries and cannot be shipped overseas

perfume.reason: perfume is a flammable liquid (Buyee prohibited items)

alcohol.reason: alcohol is a flammable liquid (Buyee prohibited items)

nail_polish.reason: nail polish is a flammable liquid (Buyee prohibited items)

aerosol.reason: aerosol spray cans are dangerous goods that cannot be shipped out

lighter.reason: lighters and lighter fuel are prohibited

airgun.reason: airguns and gas guns are prohibited

lead_acid_battery.reason: lead-acid batteries are corrosive and prohibited

coins.reason: coins and paper money are prohibited

jewelry.reason: precious metals and jewelry are prohibited

prohibited.note: Categories Buyee will not ship internationally at all. Knives / weapons / tableware are restricted per carrier (FedEx, Buyee Air Delivery, ECMS) but not on the all-countries list, so they still ship via Japan Post and are not blocked here.

lithium_installed_max.note: Items with installed / built-in lithium batteries: max 2 per package, shippable via Japan Post EMS/AIR/Sea Mail and DHL/FedEx. listing.fields['lithium_batteries'] > 2 is blocked.
